template.name: hardware info
template.description:
PostgreSQL: WITH eligible_hosts AS( SELECT hostid, host, name FROM hosts WHERE status = 0 AND flags = 0), string_inventory AS ( SELECT i.hostid, i.key_, latest.value FROM items i JOIN eligible_hosts h ON h.hostid = i.hostid JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT hs.value FROM history_str hs WHERE hs.itemid = i.itemid ORDER BY hs.clock DESC, hs.ns DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON TRUE WHERE i.status = 0 AND i.flags = 0 AND i.key_ IN ( 'inventory.cpu.model', 'inventory.ip.address', 'inventory.hostname', 'inventory.operating.system' ) ), uint_inventory AS ( SELECT i.hostid, i.key_, latest.value FROM items i JOIN eligible_hosts h ON h.hostid = i.hostid JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT hu.value FROM history_uint hu WHERE hu.itemid = i.itemid ORDER BY hu.clock DESC, hu.ns DESC LIMIT 1 ) latest ON TRUE WHERE i.status = 0 AND i.flags = 0 AND i.key_ IN ( 'inventory.mem', 'inventory.total.disk', 'inventory.cpus' ) ), string_pivot AS ( SELECT hostid, MAX(value) FILTER ( WHERE key_ = 'inventory.cpu.model' ) AS cpu_model, MAX(value) FILTER ( WHERE key_ = 'inventory.hostname' ) AS hostname, MAX(value) FILTER ( WHERE key_ = 'inventory.ip.address' ) AS ip_address, MAX(value) FILTER ( WHERE key_ = 'inventory.operating.system' ) AS operating_system FROM string_inventory GROUP BY hostid ), uint_pivot AS ( SELECT hostid, TRUNC(MAX(value) FILTER ( WHERE key_ = 'inventory.mem' ) / 1024 / 1024 / 1024) AS memory_gb, TRUNC(MAX(value) FILTER ( WHERE key_ = 'inventory.total.disk' ) / 1024 / 1024 / 1024) AS disk_gb, MAX(value) FILTER ( WHERE key_ = 'inventory.cpus' ) AS CPUs FROM uint_inventory GROUP BY hostid ) SELECT h.host, h.name, s.cpu_model, s.ip_address, s.operating_system, u.memory_gb, u.disk_gb, u.CPUs FROM eligible_hosts h LEFT JOIN string_pivot s ON s.hostid = h.hostid LEFT JOIN uint_pivot u ON u.hostid = h.hostid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM items i WHERE i.hostid = h.hostid AND i.status = 0 AND i.flags = 0 AND i.key_ IN ( 'inventory.cpu.model', 'inventory.ip.address', 'inventory.hostname', 'inventory.operating.system', 'inventory.mem', 'inventory.total.disk', 'inventory.cpus' ) ) ORDER BY h.name \gx
MySQL: WITH eligible_hosts AS( SELECT hostid, host, name FROM hosts WHERE status = 0 AND flags = 0), string_latest AS ( SELECT i.hostid, i.key_, hs.value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.itemid ORDER BY hs.clock DESC, hs.ns DESC ) AS rn FROM items i JOIN eligible_hosts h ON h.hostid = i.hostid JOIN history_str hs ON hs.itemid = i.itemid WHERE i.status = 0 AND i.flags = 0 AND i.key_ IN ( 'inventory.cpu.model', 'inventory.ip.address', 'inventory.hostname', 'inventory.operating.system' ) ), uint_latest AS ( SELECT i.hostid, i.key_, hu.value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY i.itemid ORDER BY hu.clock DESC, hu.ns DESC ) AS rn FROM items i JOIN eligible_hosts h ON h.hostid = i.hostid JOIN history_uint hu ON hu.itemid = i.itemid WHERE i.status = 0 AND i.flags = 0 AND i.key_ IN ( 'inventory.mem', 'inventory.total.disk', 'inventory.cpus' ) ), string_pivot AS ( SELECT hostid, MAX(CASE WHEN key_ = 'inventory.cpu.model' THEN value END) AS cpu_model, MAX(CASE WHEN key_ = 'inventory.hostname' THEN value END) AS hostname, MAX(CASE WHEN key_ = 'inventory.ip.address' THEN value END) AS ip_address, MAX(CASE WHEN key_ = 'inventory.operating.system' THEN value END) AS operating_system FROM string_latest WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY hostid ), uint_pivot AS ( SELECT hostid, TRUNCATE(MAX(CASE WHEN key_ = 'inventory.mem' THEN value END) / 1024 / 1024 / 1024, 0) AS memory_gb, TRUNCATE(MAX(CASE WHEN key_ = 'inventory.total.disk' THEN value END) / 1024 / 1024 / 1024, 0) AS disk_gb, MAX(CASE WHEN key_ = 'inventory.cpus' THEN value END) AS CPUs FROM uint_latest WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY hostid ) SELECT h.host, h.name, s.cpu_model, s.ip_address, s.operating_system, u.memory_gb, u.disk_gb, u.CPUs FROM eligible_hosts h LEFT JOIN string_pivot s ON s.hostid = h.hostid LEFT JOIN uint_pivot u ON u.hostid = h.hostid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM items i WHERE i.hostid = h.hostid AND i.status = 0 AND i.flags = 0 AND i.key_ IN ( 'inventory.cpu.model', 'inventory.ip.address', 'inventory.hostname', 'inventory.operating.system', 'inventory.mem', 'inventory.total.disk', 'inventory.cpus' ) ) ORDER BY h.name;
